exception.reason: UvA’s published schedules differ on compulsory second- and third-year courses, including whether Robots that Learn is required. The regulations confirm the first year for September 2026 entrants and specify later years for earlier cohorts. The upper-year requirements for September 2026 entrants remain to be confirmed.
exception.curriculumContext: The adopted regulations specify the full 60 EC first year for September 2026 entrants. The two upper-year grids share 42 EC of named second-year work and 54 EC in year three, including at least 30 EC of free electives and the 18 EC final project. The other 24 EC depend on the applicable upper-year rules.

audience.programmeDescription: Artificial Intelligence at the University of Amsterdam combines mathematics and computing with the study of cognition, language and how intelligent systems learn.
